prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Create one premium photorealistic golf-game aerial background by materializing this exact geometry guide. Course: Sheboygan Straits, an original Lake Michigan links course inspired by the visual atmosphere of Whistling Straits. Strict orthographic straight-down aerial, 2:1 landscape, preserve complete framing and every shape's location/extent. This is a playable map: KEEP ALL beige bunker shapes, their separate lobes and exact positions, the green at right, small tee at left, fairway and blue water boundaries. Do not add, remove, merge or relocate hazards. Dark green = close-cut fairway; light lime = tee/putting green; olive = medium rough; ochre surrounds = dense tawny gold fescue on rolling dunes; beige = pale ivory sand bunkers with rugged scalloped grass lips and short shadows; blue = Lake Michigan or inland water. Render continuous detailed natural materials, subtle fairway stripes, intricate sand raking, wispy fescue tufts, windswept dunes, natural limestone shoreline with fine waves INSIDE water only, deep slate-blue lake with muted teal shallows. Open treeless Wisconsin links, no forest, no tropical water, no buildings. Moderate soft side sunlight, shadows short enough to see every bunker clearly, rich but realistic greens, warm fescue and bright distinct sand. No text, numbers, flags, balls, people, paths, UI, border, perspective, sky or horizon. Do not turn fairway into a uniform ribbon; honor the guide's varying widths and irregular sand edges. Output same 1536x768 aspect ratio. Material realism without changing scoring boundaries.
references: sheboygan-straits-NN-v1-guide.png; own original geometry, one image per hole
registration: Final geometry reviewed against generated imagery; no third-party imagery bundled.
